Confirmed: `BridgeHostBindings.extractInboundMessageFields` requires `(message: unknown) => unknown`, but the real function has a narrower parameter (`msg: SDKMessage`) and a narrower return type. This is a function-parameter contravariance mismatch, not an optional-field-narrower-than-assigned-value case — the given patrón doesn't cover it, so I'm not touching it.
